formal_statement: ¬ (∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 4 → ℂ), Module.finrank ℂ L = 6 ∧ ∀ t ∈ L, Matrix.permanent (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin 4) => (if i = j then (2 : ℂ) else 1) + t (i, j)) = 65)
plain_statement: The negation, wrapped whole, of the statement that some 6-dimensional linear space L of 4 x 4 complex matrices keeps the permanent of the matrix with 2 + t(i, i) on the diagonal and 1 + t(i, j) elsewhere equal to 65 for every t in L. Equivalent to: every such space has dimension at most 5. Conjecture.
title: Probe: at the 4 x 4 base point with 2 on the diagonal and 1 elsewhere, no six-dimensional level space keeps the permanent at 65
